note: PROTECTED. The rules a candidate is approved under. A proposal to change this file is a separate decision routed to the chief of staff; no candidate can change the rules used to approve itself.

decision_rule.accept: Every hard gate PASSED, and the 95% interval of the paired difference in the primary metric against the incumbent lies above zero. A declared simplification is accepted when it is non-inferior within the margin and its cost interval lies below zero.
decision_rule.reject: Any hard gate FAILED, or the 95% interval of the paired difference lies below zero.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Anything else, including a hard gate that is REMAINING. Reported as no demonstrated improvement; the candidate and its results are kept.

exploration.note: Total experiment units all experiments together may use. An experiment that would exceed it is not opened; raising it is a decision for the chief of staff.
